name: Lead Qualifier
description: Scores inbound leads 1-100 based on fit, budget, timeline, authority, need. Flags high-potential and unqualified leads. Integrates with HubSpot for lead data.
a2a_endpoint: POST /a2a with method: message/send, skill: lead-qualifier

examples.input: Score these 5 inbound leads from our website form
examples.output: Lead scores (1-100) with reasoning per lead, high-potential flag, recommended next action
Score: 92/100 (high fit), recommended: discovery call within 24h
